query: UPDATE templates SET display_name=$2,image=$3,capabilities=$4,cpu_millicores=$5,memory_bytes=$6,pids=$12,workspace_bytes=$13,is_default=$7,enabled=$8,version=$9,description=$11,last_set_by='admin',clamped_from=NULL,sizes_from_limits=false,builtin_image_created=NULL,builtin_updated_at=NULL,customised_builtin=(templates.last_set_by='builtin' OR templates.customised_builtin),builtin_base_image=CASE WHEN templates.last_set_by='builtin' THEN templates.image ELSE templates.builtin_base_image END,check_state=CASE WHEN $10 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE check_state END,check_reason=CASE WHEN $10 THEN NULL ELSE check_reason END,checked_version=CASE WHEN $10 THEN NULL WHEN checked_version=version THEN $9 ELSE checked_version END,base=CASE WHEN $10 THEN NULL ELSE base END,image_id=CASE WHEN $10 THEN NULL ELSE image_id END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name=$1
